title: Implement minimal cmdr-dev kernel
goal: Create a dependency-minimal CLI that can validate repository bootstrap state, report execution status and select the next executable work unit.
why_now: A deterministic recovery and navigation primitive is required before larger autonomous-engineering features are built.
definition_of_done: CLI parses canonical JSON state and graph
doctor detects malformed or inconsistent bootstrap state
status reports current phase and active/preferred work
next deterministically selects a READY executable node
unit tests cover core selection and validation behavior
no third-party runtime dependency is introduced
